title: Example 130 (B9, own checker, violation) with the previous record built in its witness
description: jvmcontract's equivalence and prove outcomes now keep each counterexample's witness as data (the second half of step 3b of llm-dlc/loops/build-orchestration.md): typed inputs with exact values (a long as a decimal string, a float or double as Java's toString), the patched version's call (class, class file, descriptor, static or not, the receiver as a record of its components, each argument naming the input it came from) and for a regression proof the previous version's call, whose arguments under previousArguments name the expression that computed them. build.py records it as counterexamples[].witness, with each class file's SHA-256 as built. The verdict and every other field must be unchanged; the counterexample must gain a witness that validates against the schema. 130 builds the previous version's Backoff record by a constructor call among previousArguments: previousCall.receiver must be a record of two components whose from are the expressions this.baseMillis and this.capMillis.
expected: example 130 gives its expected verdict, violation: build.py prints 'as expected' and exits 0

resources.notes: the own checker, 9 s at most
